center.eyebrow: Micro-label above section title categorizing why direct access wins (e.g., 'Why direct access wins'). Max 4 words.
center.h2: Section title introducing value pillars of hiring the specialist (e.g., 'What you get working with me'). Max 6 words.

value-card.h3: Title of the value proposition card tailored to the profession (e.g., 'Expert ML solutions', 'Direct engineer access'). Max 3-4 words.
value-card.p: Description explaining the specific benefit to businesses in {{STATE}}. Exactly 1-2 sentences.

prose-grid.eyebrow: Micro-label categorizing the section (e.g., 'Plain answer'). Max 2 words.
prose-grid.h2: Heading asking what the specialist actually does in the target city (e.g., 'What does a Machine Learning Engineer in {{CITY}} actually do?'). Must include {{CITY}}.

answer-card.tag: Tag label for quick summary (e.g., 'Quick answer'). Max 2 words.
answer-card.p: Concise TL;DR summary defining the core services delivered by the specialist in {{CITY}}. Exactly 1-2 sentences.

p: Paragraph detailing the local tech context in {{CITY}} and {{STATE}}, full project lifecycle, and business outcome focus. Exactly 2-3 sentences.
checklist: Key takeaway item highlighting custom builds, MLOps/deployment reliability, or in-person collaboration in {{CITY}}. Max 1 sentence.
